comment: Pinned external data files. URLs point to immutable refs (commit SHA / versioned release). SHA256 computed at first download (2026-06-11) and verified on every run of scripts/download_data.py. No other network access exists in this project.

files.name: desi_gaussian_bao_ALL_GCcomb_mean.txt
files.description: DESI DR2 BAO measurements, all tracers (13 points). CobayaSampler/bao_data at commit b7b8a36 (= tag v2.6, sole commit touching desi_bao_dr2/).

files.name: desi_gaussian_bao_ALL_GCcomb_cov.txt
files.description: 13x13 covariance for the DESI DR2 BAO measurements (block-diagonal per tracer). Same pinned commit as the mean file.

files.name: desi_dr2_cmb_compressed_prior.yaml
files.description: Official DESI DR2 cobaya chain config (base_w_wa, desi-bao-all + compressed CMB prior). Source of the full-precision (thetastar, ombh2, ombch2) means and covariance matching arXiv:2503.14738v3 Eqs. (35)-(36).
